MTS 102 CHEAT SHEET

Test-Ready Summary

Compiled by Felix the Astro-Coder

1. Limits

lim(x→a) f(x) = L → Plug in directly unless indeterminate

At infinity: Divide numerator and denominator by highest power of x

Special: lim(x→0) (sin x)/x = 1

2. First Principles (Definition of Derivative)

f′(x) = lim(h→0) [(f(x + h) - f(x)) / h]

3. Differentiation Rules

Power Rule: d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹

Product Rule: d/dx(uv) = u′v + uv′

Quotient Rule: d/dx(u/v) = (u′v - uv′) / v²

MCCOY
The Genuine Man
(TGM)
